purpose: Exploratory one-time detector initialization pilot motivated by labeled-empty initial prompts and poor automatic boxes. Reuse official Ultralytics YOLOv8n training and the existing one-shot YOLO/SAM2 pipeline. This tests prompt quality before any propagation; it is not a replacement for the user's native/Lean comparisons.
source_data: Use the local PolypGen center-wise single-frame images, masks and supplied VOC-style box text annotations only. Train centers C1 through C5; reserve all C6 for detector validation. Exclude every image in an exact decoded-image duplicate group rather than choosing among conflicting labels. Exclude examples with missing or ambiguous masks/box files, invalid boxes, positive mask with empty box, empty mask with positive box, and positive masks for which supplied boxes cover under 99 percent of mask foreground. This 99-percent criterion is an annotation-quality audit rule, not an inference gate or confidence threshold. Record all exclusions and hashes. The mask for C3_EndoCV2021_00489].jpg appears to have a filename typo; it also has no box file and is excluded without modifying source files.
leakage_limitations: Independently verified exact RGB comparison found no exact still-image matches among all 2225 sequence frames, and C6 has no exact image match in C1-C5. Exact equality does not rule out re-encodings, neighboring video frames or same-patient data. Patient/video identity is unknown and all sequences were inspected; evaluation is exploratory, not independent patient-level generalization. Do not use sequence masks for model training or selection.
staging: Stage derived labels and independent byte-identical image copies only under the requested Google Drive experiment output, so any upstream image repair cannot modify original source files. Require complete JPEG end markers and normal EXIF orientation before training. Convert supplied VOC-style xyxy coordinates to normalized xywh using the installed official Ultralytics utility. Preserve multiple boxes and empty negative files; independently verify every staged file, source hash, label and center assignment. Never change original images, masks or annotations. Freeze all source and training inputs.
training: Initialize the official COCO-pretrained YOLOv8n asset from Ultralytics release v8.2.0, not the existing PolypGen checkpoint with unknown training split. Use installed Ultralytics trainer, 20 epochs, image size 640, batch 8, seed 20261114, workers 0, device MPS, AMP disabled, cache disabled, deterministic requested, no early stopping. C6 is the only model-validation center. Record software, configuration, checkpoint hashes, logs, exact exclusions and MPS determinism limits; do not claim MPS training is bitwise reproducible.
evaluation: First evaluate only the four saved automatic first-detection frames at the original frame index, cropping seq23 to its already defined inset-free viewport before detector inference. Run each trained model inference exactly once per frame per reproducibility process at the same existing confidence 0.25, IoU 0.7, image size 640 and class 0 as the baseline. A missing detection means no initial box, not a reason to search later frames. Open GT only after all boxes are frozen. Compare box overlap/coverage, labeled-empty false alarms and YOLO proposal availability with the saved original boxes; then decode SAM2 prompts only where boxes exist using the fixed checkpoint, including a matched original box and explicit oracle control. No new redetection, inference confidence gate or threshold. Full videos only if these fixed-frame results and controls justify further evaluation.
